whyThisIsNotCosmetic: It is self-contradictory on the artifact's own bytes. reviewStatus is AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW. An artifact that has not been reviewed cannot have Stage A findings raised against it. purpose asserts two, in the same file that declares no review exists.

The lineage's own convention resolves the tokens the other way, and the artifact breaks it. In the dual-ACCEPTed sibling sarif-fc-nonauth-term-golden.v3 (de3c859b…, recorded by D-296 at HEAD), the same sentence pattern reads 'Land the Claude Stage A golden.v2 SHOULD-FIX … Continue to land the Codex golden.v1 SHOULD-FIX … Fixture files remain the golden.v1 paths and digests. Frozen golden.v1 and golden.v2 stay unmoved.' There, v3 is the speaker and the version tokens name the reviewed predecessors. Under that settled reading, 'golden.v2 SHOULD-FIX' in a golden.v2 artifact denotes a finding against itself, which does not exist. The convention is not ambiguous; this artifact is the outlier.

It is the exact defect class the sibling lineage was forced to spend a successor version repairing. golden.v3's stated purpose was to 'rename the ten load-bearing fields that still spoke as golden.v1 so they state golden.v3's own standing.' That was a Claude Stage A SHOULD-FIX on golden.v2 of the FC-NONAUTH-TERM line. The present defect is the mirror image — fields speaking as golden.v2 where the referent is golden.v1 — and letting it through would re-open, in the FC-OUTFAIL line, the review cost the FC-NONAUTH-TERM line has already paid.

It corrupts custody at the point of record. purpose is the field a later D-000 recording quotes when it pins what a successor did. Recorded as written, it enters the permanent record that golden.v2 was reviewed at Stage A and rejected before its Stage A review existed, and that golden.v2 authored a fixture that golden.v1 authored. D-294 (ADOPTED at HEAD) settled that cross-lineage citations are custody at recording; this is custody stated wrongly inside a single lineage.

The artifact demonstrates it knows better everywhere else. basedOn.predecessorGoldenV1.role closes with 'Not this artifact's version number.' — an explicit guard against exactly this collapse. A regex sweep of every string leaf found the misattribution confined to purpose; all other version tokens resolve correctly. That the guard is stated in one field and violated in another is what makes this a defect rather than a house style.

No attack-list bullet is reached, nothing in doesNot or failsIf is violated, and the technical content of the artifact stands. The defect is custody of lineage prose, not truth of the fixture claim.
